extracted.intended_audience: microbiology students, laboratory technicians, and practising bacteriologists preparing culture media
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed laboratory protocols and recipes for preparing a wide range of bacteriological culture media, reagents, and related sterile supports (agar, gelatine, bouillons, specialised media), including temperatures, concentrations, clarification, and sterilisation steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Iron Peptone Solution (Pakes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Peptone 30 g emulsified in 200 c.c. tap water at ~60°C, washed into 1 L with 800 c.c. tap water; salt 5 g and sodium phosphate 3 g dissolved; heat in steamer 100°C for 30 minutes, filter, fill into 10 c.c tubes; add 0.1 c.c of 2% neutral ferric tartrate to each tube (yellowish-white precipitate forms); sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep initial emulsification warm; use 10 c.c tubes; expect precipitate on addition of ferric tartrate; sterilisation follows nutrient bouillon procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead Peptone Solution
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepared as for Iron Peptone Solution but in step of adding ferric tartrate substitute 0.1 c.c of 1% neutral aqueous lead acetate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same preparation and sterilisation as Iron Peptone Solution; reagent substitution noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nitrate Peptone Solution (Pakes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Witte's peptone 10 g emulsified in 200 c.c. ammonia-free distilled water at 60°C; make up to 1000 c.c., heat in steamer 100°C for 20 minutes; add sodium nitrate 1 g, filter, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use ammonia-free water; follow same sterilisation as nutrient bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litmus Bouillon
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare nutrient bouillon (1000 c.c.), add sufficient sterile litmus solution to tint medium dark lavender (media rendered +10 usually react very faintly alkaline or occasionally neutral to litmus), tube and sterilise as for bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Colour/tint indicates reaction; note litmus reaction guidance (+10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rosolic Acid Peptone Solution
rubrics_metrics.description: Stock: rosolic acid 0.5 g dissolved in 100 c.c. 80% alcohol. Mix 100 c.c. peptone water (Dunham) with 2 c.c. stock, heat in steamer 100°C for 30 minutes, filter, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep rosolic acid stock; sterilise as nutrient bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capaldi-Proskauer Medium, No. I
rubrics_metrics.description: Sodium chloride 2.0 g, magnesium sulphate 0.1 g, calcium chloride 0.2 g, monopotassium phosphate 2.0 g dissolved in 1000 c.c. water; add asparagin 2 g and mannite 2 g; titrate 25 c.c against decinormal sodic hydrate using litmus, adjust remainder to neutral to litmus by adding estimated sodic hydrate; filter, add litmus solution 47.5 c.c (=5%), tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Careful titration/neutralisation step to neutral to litmus; add litmus 5%; sterilise as nutrient bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capaldi-Proskauer Medium No. II
rubrics_metrics.description: Peptone 20 g and mannite 1 g dissolved in 1000 c.c. water; neutralise to litmus as in No. I, filter, add litmus solution 47.5 c.c (=5%), tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Same neutralisation and litmus addition as No. I; sterilise as nutrient bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Urine Media. Bouillon
rubrics_metrics.description: Collect freshly passed urine in sterile flask, place in steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes, filter through two thicknesses of Swedish filter paper, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon (leave reaction unaltered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not alter reaction; sterility achieved via steaming and standard bouillon sterilisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Urine Gelatine
rubrics_metrics.description: Collect urine, adjust specific gravity to 1010 if above by diluting with sterile water; estimate reaction at boiling point and note; add gelatine to 10% and heat in steamer at 100°C for 1 hour to dissolve; estimate reaction and add caustic soda to restore original urine reaction; cool to 60°C and clarify with egg as for nutrient gelatine, filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Control specific gravity and reaction; clarify with egg; sterilisation follows nutrient gelatine routine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Urine Gelatine (Heller)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter urine through animal charcoal, adjust specific gravity to 1010 if necessary; add Witte's peptone 1%, salt 0.5%, gelatine 10%; heat in steamer 100°C for 1 hour; add caustic soda in small quantities until fluid reacts faintly alkaline to litmus; cool to 60°C, clarify with egg, filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use charcoal filtration to remove colour; careful alkaline adjustment to faintly alkaline; follow clarifying and sterilisation steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Urine Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: Collect urine, adjust specific gravity to 1010 if above by diluting; add powdered agar 1.5% or 2%; heat in steamer at 100°C for 90 minutes to dissolve agar; cool to 60°C, clarify with egg, filter through papier Chardin using hot-water funnel, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar (leave reaction unaltered).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Longer heating to dissolve agar; clarify and filter hot; maintain original reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serum Sugar Media (Hiss)
rubrics_metrics.description: Media in which carbohydrate fermentation is indicated by coagulation of serum proteids and acid production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to detect carbohydrate fermentation by both coagulation and acid reaction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serum Dextrose Water (Hiss)
rubrics_metrics.description: Serum water 1000 c.c.; dextrose 10 g dissolved; filter, add litmus solution (Kahlbaum) 50 c.c; tube 10 c.c and sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 20 minutes on each of three successive days. Other sugars may substitute for dextrose in similar amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three successive days of 20-minute steaming for sterilisation; sugar substitutions permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omeliansky's Nutrient Fluid (For Cellulose Fermenters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Potassium phosphate 4.0 g, magnesium sulphate 2.0 g, ammonium sulphate 4.0 g, sodium chloride 0.25 g dissolved in 4000 c.c. distilled water; flask in quantities of 250 c.c., add 5 g precipitated chalk to each flask; sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 20 minutes on each of three successive days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used for cellulose fermenters; add precipitated chalk to each flask before sterilisation; three-day steaming regimen.

rubrics_metrics.name: Milk Rice (Eisenberg)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mix nutrient bouillon 70 c.c. with milk 210 c.c.; rub 100 g rice powder with the mixture to a paste, fill sterile capsules to ~0.5 cm layer, heat over water-bath at 100°C until solidified, replace lids and sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes on each of three consecutive days (produces medium the colour of cafe au lait).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produces solid medium resembling cafe au lait; triple-day sterilisation recommended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Milk Rice (Soyka)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mix nutrient bouillon 50 c.c. with milk 150 c.c.; rub 100 g rice powder to a paste, fill sterile capsules, replace lids and sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes on each of three consecutive days (produces pure white opaque medium).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure similar to Eisenberg but different proportions to yield opaque white medium.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fish Bouillon
rubrics_metrics.description: Use 500 g herring/mackerel/cod; add NaCl 26.5 g, KCl 0.75 g, MgCl2 3.25 g dissolved in 500 c.c distilled water and add to fish; heat gently 40°C for 20 minutes then bring rapidly to boiling for 10 minutes; strain through butter muslin, add peptone 5 g emulsified in ~200 c.c hot fish water, heat in steamer at 100°C for 20 minutes, filter through Swedish filter paper; if used fluid make up to 1000 c.c, if for agar/gelatine store double strength; tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon. Marvis fish food (16 g) may substitute 500 g fresh fish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Option to use Marvis substitute; store double-strength when intended for solid media; standard filtration and sterilisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fish Gelatine
rubrics_metrics.description: Use double strength fish bouillon 500 c.c in tared 2-L flask; add sheet gelatine 100 g cut into small pieces; bubble live steam 15 minutes to dissolve gelatine, weigh and adjust to 1 L mass (1135.5 g) with distilled water at 100°C, cool <60°C and clarify with egg, filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine. Shake well after final sterilisation to aerate medium.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tared-flask weight adjustments to exact mass; clarify with egg; aerate by shaking after sterilisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fish Gelatine-Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: Emulsify 5 g powdered agar with 200 c.c double strength fish bouillon, wash into tared 2-L flask with 300 c.c fish bouillon; add sheet gelatine 70 g, bubble live steam to dissolve gelatine and agar, adjust weight to 1 L mass (1110.5 g) with distilled water at 100°C, cool <60°C and clarify with egg, filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine. Shake after final sterilisation to aerate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Precise weight adjustments; clarify with egg; aerate after sterilisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pasteur's Solution
rubrics_metrics.description: Reaction alkaline. Mix ash from 10 g yeast, ammonium tartrate 10 g, cane sugar 100 g, dissolve in 1000 c.c distilled water; tube or flask and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alkaline reaction expected; sterilise as nutrient bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yeast Water (Pasteur)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pressed yeast 75 g in 2-L flask with 1000 c.c distilled water; heat in steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes, filter through papier Chardin, tube or flask and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard steaming and filtration; use papier Chardin filter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cohn's Solution
rubrics_metrics.description: Acid potassium phosphate (KH2PO4) 5.0 g, calcium phosphate 0.5 g, magnesium sulphate 5.0 g, ammonium tartrate 10.0 g dissolved in 1000 c.c distilled water; tube or flask and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple mineral solution; sterilise as for bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Naegeli's Solution
rubrics_metrics.description: Dibasic potassium phosphate (K2HPO4) 1.0 g, magnesium sulphate 0.2 g, calcium chloride 0.1 g, ammonium tartrate 10.0 g dissolved in 1000 c.c distilled water; tube or flask and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mineral-salt based solution; sterilise as bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plaster-of-Paris Discs
rubrics_metrics.description: Make cork moulds 2.5 cm diameter covered with note-paper ridge; mix plaster-of-Paris into stiff paste with distilled water, fill moulds, set and remove paper, sterilise discs on asbestos board in hot-air oven at 150°C for 30 minutes; remove sterile discs with sterile forceps into sterile capsule, moisten with sterile water, then sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes on each of three consecutive days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-stage sterilisation: dry-heat oven then triple-day steaming; handle with sterile forceps; moisten discs before final steaming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gypsum Blocks (Engel and Hansen)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare truncated-cone tin moulds (base 5.5 cm, apex 4 cm, height 4.5–5 cm); mix powdered calcined gypsum with distilled water to stiff paste, fill moulds, set and air-dry, remove blocks and sterilise in double glass dish in hot-air oven 115°C for 1 hour; open dish, add sterile distilled water to moisten block forming 1 cm deep layer in bottom of dish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use double glass dish for oven sterilisation; final moistening in sterile dish to create humid environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wine Must
rubrics_metrics.description: "Wine must" (concentrated syrup from Sicily) 200 g in 2-L flask with 800 c.c distilled water; add ammonium tartrate 5 g; place in 60°C water-bath 1 hour with frequent shaking, filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use non-sterile concentrated must diluted and heated at 60°C before filtration and sterilisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wheat Bouillon (Gasperini)
rubrics_metrics.description: Wheat flour 150 g, magnesium sulphate 0.5 g, potassium nitrate 1 g, glucose 15 g dissolved in 1000 c.c water heated to 100°C; filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filter after boiling; sterilise as bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bread Paste
rubrics_metrics.description: Grate stale bread finely, distribute crumbs in sterile Erlenmeyer flasks to ~1 cm layer, add enough distilled water to soak crumbs without covering, plug flasks and sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes on each of four consecutive days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Four-day steaming regimen specified; do not over-liquidate; maintain sterile plugs.

rubrics_metrics.name: French Proof Agar (Sabouraud)
rubrics_metrics.description: Chassaing's peptone 10 g emulsified in 200 c.c distilled water at 60°C; powdered agar 13 g emulsified in 200 c.c cold distilled water; mix emulsions and wash into tared 2-L flask with 600 c.c distilled water; bubble live steam 20 minutes to dissolve agar, cool to 60°C and clarify with egg as for nutrient agar, filter through Papier Chardin using hot-water funnel; add French maltose 40 g, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify with egg; use hot-water funnel for filtration; specific maltose addition for Sabouraud medium.

rubrics_metrics.name: English Proof Agar (Blaxall)
rubrics_metrics.description: Substitute Witte's peptone for Chassaing's peptone and proceed as for French Proof Agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only peptone substitution differentiates from French Proof Agar.

rubrics_metrics.name: French Mannite Agar (Sabouraud) (For cultivation of Favus)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proceed as French Proof Agar but substitute Mannite (38 g) for maltose.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted for Favus cultivation; carbohydrate substitution noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gelatine Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepared by adding sufficient agar to nutrient gelatine to ensure solidity at incubation temperatures above 22°C; for incubation at 30°C use 10% gelatine + 0.5% agar in meat extract before peptone/salt addition; for 37°C use 12% gelatine + 0.75% agar; avoid adding more agar than necessary as it may retard liquefying organisms. Steps: measure 400 c.c double strength meat extract, add gelatine 100 g, add powdered agar 5 g emulsified with 100 c.c cold water, dissolve by live steam 20 minutes, add peptone 10 g salt 5 g emulsified in 100 c.c double strength meat extract, steamer 15 minutes, adjust weight to 1 L (1120 g) with distilled water at 100°C, estimate reaction and render to +10 with caustic soda, steamer 20 minutes, cool to 60°C, clarify with egg, filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust agar/gelatine proportions for incubation temperature; control reaction to +10; avoid excess agar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agar Gelatine (Guarniari)
rubrics_metrics.description: Double strength meat extract 400 c.c with gelatine 50 g; powdered agar 3 g emulsified in 50 c.c cold water; dissolve by live steam 20 minutes; add Witte's peptone 25 g and salt 5 g emulsified in 100 c.c double strength meat extract at 60°C, steamer 15 minutes, adjust mass to 1 L (1083 g) with distilled water at 100°C; neutralise carefully to litmus with small additions of normal soda, steamer 20 minutes, cool to 60°C and clarify with egg, filter through papier Chardin using hot-water funnel, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Careful neutralisation to litmus; clarify with egg; precise mass adjustments required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whey Gelatine
rubrics_metrics.description: Curdle fresh milk by warming to 60°C and adding rennet; filter off whey into sterile tared flask, note reaction; add gelatine 10% and bubble live steam 15 minutes to dissolve, weigh and estimate reaction of medium mass and add caustic soda to restore reaction equivalent to original whey; cool to 60°C, clarify with egg, filter, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restore reaction to original whey equivalence; clarify with egg; sterile handling required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whey Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: Curdle milk at 60°C with rennet, filter whey into sterile flask, add agar 1.5–2%, bubble live steam 20 minutes to dissolve agar, cool to 60°C, clarify with egg as for nutrient agar, filter through papier Chardin using hot-water funnel, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarification and filtration steps similar to whey gelatine; agar concentration specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litmus Whey
rubrics_metrics.description: Curdle milk at 60°C with rennet, filter whey into sterile flask, neutralise to litmus using citric acid solution 4% (do not use mineral acid), heat in steamer at 100°C for 1 hour to coagulate proteid; if whey cloudy allow 48 hours in ice chest and decant or filter through Berkefeld candle, filter into sterile flask, tint with litmus solution to deep purple red, tube and sterilise as for milk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use citric acid not mineral acid; coagulate proteid by heating; optional long cold settling or Berkefeld filtration if cloudy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litmus Whey (Petruschky)
rubrics_metrics.description: Milk 1000 c.c plus HCl or glacial acetic acid 1.5 c.c, boil and filter off coagulated casein, neutralise to litmus by n/1 caustic soda and boil (whey becomes cloudy and acid), neutralise again to litmus with n/10 caustic soda, filter, tint with neutral litmus to deep purple, tube and sterilise as for milk.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-step neutralisation with different strengths of caustic soda; boiling between steps; use neutral litmus for tinting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litmus Whey Gelatine
rubrics_metrics.description: Milk 1000 c.c, add HCl or glacial acetic acid 1.5 c.c and boil 5 minutes, filter casein and make whey faintly alkaline to litmus; add peptone 10 g emulsified and gelatine 50 g, dissolve by live steam, clear with egg and filter, adjust weight to 1 L (1060 g) with distilled water, add dextrose 15 g, tint with sterile litmus to required tint, tube and sterilise 20 minutes in steamer at 100°C on each of five successive days. Medium remains semi-fluid at room temperature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Five-day 20-minute steaming sterilisation; produces semi-fluid medium suitable for cool or hot incubator.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litmus Whey Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepared similarly to Whey Gelatine with substitution of 15 g agar for gelatine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Analogous steps to litmus whey gelatine but with agar instead of gelatine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Malt Extract Solution (Herschell)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distilled water 1000 c.c; extractum malti (malt extract) 25 g added, boil 5 minutes, allow to stand and decant off clear fluid from sediment, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decant clear fluid after settling; sterilise as bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earthy Salts Agar (Lipman and Brown) (For enumeration of soil organisms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agar 20 g emulsified in 200 c.c distilled water and washed into tared 2-L flask with 400 c.c distilled water; peptone 0.5 g emulsified in 50 c.c distilled water added; bubble live steam 20 minutes to dissolve agar; add dextrose 10 g, potassium phosphate 0.5 g, magnesium sulphate 0.2 g, potassium nitrate 0.06 g; adjust weight to 1 L (1025 g) with distilled water at 100°C; titrate medium mass and adjust reaction to +5; cool to 60°C, clarify with egg and filter; tube in 10 c.c quantities and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically titrate to reaction +5; intended for soil organism enumeration; clarify with egg.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beyrinck's Solution I (For cultivation of nitrogen fixing organisms)
rubrics_metrics.description: 1 g potassium hydrogen phosphate, 0.2 g magnesium sulphate, 0.02 g sodium chloride dissolved in 1000 c.c water; add 1 c.c of 1/1000 aqueous ferrous sulphate and 1 c.c of 1/1000 manganese sulphate; add 20 g dextrose (up to 40 g may be used); steam 20 minutes, filter, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add trace iron and manganese solutions; dextrose amount variable depending on organism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beyrinck's Solution II (For growth of Azobacter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proceed as in Solution I but substitute mannite for dextrose in step of carbohydrate addition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carbohydrate substitution targeted for Azobacter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Winogradsky's Solution (for Nitric Organisms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Potassium phosphate 1.0 g, magnesium sulphate 0.5 g, calcium chloride 0.01 g, sodium chloride 2.0 g dissolved in 1000 c.c distilled water; fill into flasks 20 c.c each, add small quantity freshly washed magnesium carbonate to each; sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 20 minutes on each of three consecutive days; add 2 c.c sterile 2% ammonium sulphate to each 20 c.c flask, incubate at 37°C for 48 hours, discard contaminated flasks and store remainder for future use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-day steaming, then amend with ammonium sulphate and incubate to check sterility and activity; discard contaminated flasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Winogradsky's Solution (for Nitrous Organisms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ammonium sulphate 1 g, potassium sulphate 1 g dissolved in 1000 c.c distilled water; add 5–10 g basic magnesium carbonate (previously sterilised by boiling); fill into flasks and sterilise as for previous solution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addition of sterilised basic magnesium carbonate; sterilisation consistent with other Winogradsky solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Silicate Jelly (Winogradsky)
rubrics_metrics.description: Solution A: ammonium sulphate 0.40 g, magnesium sulphate 0.05 g, calcium chloride 0.01 g dissolved in 50 c.c water. Solution B: potassium phosphate 0.10 g, sodium carbonate 0.60 g dissolved in 50 c.c water. Silicic acid 3.4 g dissolved in 100 c.c water. Pour silicic acid into basin, mix equal quantities of A and B then add in successive small quantities to silicic acid with continuous stirring until jelly formed; spread layer of jelly over bottom of large capsules/plates; sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes on each of three consecutive days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare by mixing small aliquots to form consistent jelly; triple-day steaming for sterilisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Naehrstoff Agar (Hesse and Niedner) (For enumeration of water organisms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Agar 12.5 g emulsified in 250 c.c distilled water and washed into tared 2-L flask with further 250 c.c distilled water; dissolve by bubbling live steam; emulsify Naehrstoff-Heyden (albumose) 7.5 g in 200 c.c cold distilled water and add to melted agar; adjust weight to 1 L (1020 g) with distilled water at 100°C; clarify with white of egg and filter; tube in 10 c.c quantities and sterilise in steamer at 100°C for 20 minutes on each of three successive days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify with egg white; triple-day 20-minute steaming sterilisation; intended for water organism counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bile Salt Broth--Double Strength
rubrics_metrics.description: Witte's peptone 40 g emulsified with 300 c.c distilled water at 60°C and washed into litre flask with 600 c.c distilled water; sodium taurocholate 10 g and glucose 10 g dissolved in 100 c.c and added; heat in steamer at 100°C for 20 minutes, filter through Swedish filter paper into sterile flask; add sterile neutral litmus sufficient to colour medium deep purple; fill into 25 c.c Erlenmeyer flasks and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Double strength formulation; litmus tint deep purple indicates reaction; sterilise as nutrient bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plant Bacteria Media (vegetable tuber media like beetroot/carrot/turnip/parsnip)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepared and sterilised precisely similar to potato media (details referenced as 'prepared tubes and sterilised in a manner precisely similar to that described for potato').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow potato medium preparation protocol for these plant-based media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hay Infusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Dried hay 10 g chopped, add 1000 c.c distilled water heated to 70°C in flask, macerate in water-bath at 60°C for 3 hours, replace stopper with cotton-wool plug, heat in steamer at 100°C for 1 hour, filter through Swedish filter paper, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maceration step at 60°C for 3 hours before steaming; cotton-wool plug during steaming.

rubrics_metrics.name: Haricot Bouillon (for cultivation of bacteria from tubercles of Legumes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Distilled water 1000 c.c, haricot beans 250 g added, NaCl 10 g, and 1 c.c of 1% sodium bicarbonate; steamer at 100°C for 30 minutes, filter, add saccharose 20 g, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains saccharose addition post-filtration; used for legume tubercle bacteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Haricot Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: 400 c.c distilled water in tared 2-L flask, agar 15 g mixed into paste with 100 c.c cold water, dissolve agar by live steam; add 250 g haricot beans to flask with agar mixture, 1 c.c 1% sodium bicarbonate, 10 g NaCl, steamer 30 minutes, adjust mass to 1030 g with distilled water at 100°C, cool to 60°C, clarify with egg and filter, add saccharose 20 g, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Precise mass adjustment to experimentally obtained per-litre figure; clarify with egg.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wood Ash Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: 400 c.c distilled water in tared 2-L flask, agar 10 g made into paste with 100 c.c cold water and added; dissolve agar by live steam; prepare wood ash extract by placing 5 g clean wood ash in 200 c.c distilled water with sterile glass beads and shaking mechanically 10 minutes then heat in steamer 100°C for 30 minutes; after steamer dry outside of flask, boil for 1 minute, filter directly into flask containing melted agar, add maltose 4 g, adjust mass to 1 L (1019 g) with distilled water at 100°C, steamer 20 minutes, cool to 60°C, clarify with egg and filter, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Careful handling to avoid contamination when combining ash extract and hot agar; precise mass adjustment and clarification steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oleic Acid Agar (Fleming) (for B. acnes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ascitic fluid 250 c.c in sterile bottle with ~10 sterile glass beads; oleic acid 25 g added and emulsified by shaking 10 minutes; liquefy and measure out nutrient agar 750 c.c then cool to 55°C; mix oleic acid emulsion with agar, add 10 c.c sterile neutral red 1% aqueous solution; tube in 10 c.c, slant and allow to set; incubate 48 hours at 37°C and reject contaminated tubes; store sterile tubes for future use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emulsify oleic acid thoroughly; add neutral red indicator; incubate to confirm sterility, discard contaminated tubes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parietti's Bouillon
rubrics_metrics.description: Mix pure hydrochloric acid 4 c.c with carbolic acid solution 5% 100 c.c and allow standing a few days; add in quantities of 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 c.c by sterile pipette to tubes each containing 10 c.c previously sterilised nutrient bouillon; incubate at 37°C for 48 hours to eliminate contaminated tubes and store remainder for future use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preservative/carbolised acid admixture used to treat bouillon tubes; incubation step to eliminate contaminated tubes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carbolised Bouillon
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare nutrient bouillon 1000 c.c, add carbolic acid 1 g (2.5 or 5 g may be needed for special purposes), dissolve in medium, tube and sterilise as for bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concentration adjustable for special purposes; sterilise as bouillon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carbolised Gelatine
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare nutrient gelatine 1000 c.c, add carbolic acid 5 g (=0.5%), dissolve, filter if necessary through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine. (1 or 2.5 g may be used instead to meet special requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lower carbolic concentrations (0.1% or 0.25%) occasionally used; filter if necessary before sterilisation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Carbolised Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare nutrient agar 1000 c.c, add 1 g pure phenol and dissolve, filter if necessary through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phenol addition (carbolic) provides antiseptic property; filter if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Litmus Gelatine
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare nutrient gelatine and add sterile litmus solution sufficient to tint medium deep lavender; tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Litmus tinting indicates reaction; sterilise with gelatine protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lactose Litmus Bouillon (Lakmus Molke)
rubrics_metrics.description: Peptone 4 g emulsified with 200 c.c meat extract at 60°C; add salt 2 g and lactose 20 g and wash into sterile litre flask with 200 c.c meat extract and 600 c.c distilled water; heat in steamer 100°C for 30 minutes to dissolve, neutralise carefully to litmus with successive small additions of decinormal soda solution, steamer 20 minutes to precipitate phosphates, filter through two thicknesses of Swedish filter paper, add sterile litmus solution to colour deep purple, tube and sterilise as for bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Careful neutralisation to litmus using decinormal soda; precipitation step to remove phosphates before filtration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lactose Litmus Gelatine (Wurtz)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare nutrient gelatine, render reaction of medium mass -5, steamer 20 minutes, clarify with egg as for gelatine, add lactose 20 g (=2%), filter through papier Chardin, add sterile litmus to pale lavender, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust reaction to -5 (acidic); clarify with egg; follow gelatine sterilisation routine.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lactose Litmus Agar (Wurtz)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare nutrient agar, render reaction of medium mass -5, steamer 20 minutes, cool to 60°C and clarify with egg as for nutrient agar, add lactose 20 g (=2%), filter through papier Chardin using hot-water funnel, add sterile litmus to pale lavender, tube and sterilise as for nutrient agar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acidic reaction (-5) required; clarification and hot filtration steps described; sterilise as agar.

rubrics_metrics.name: Glycerine Potato Bouillon
rubrics_metrics.description: 1 kg potatoes washed, peeled and grated; weigh gratings and add distilled water in proportion 1 c.c per gram weight, stand in ice-chest 12 hours, strain through butter muslin, filter through Swedish filter paper into graduated cylinder, place filtrate in flask, add equal quantity distilled water and heat in steam steriliser 60 minutes, add glycerine 4% mix thoroughly and filter again, tube and sterilise as for nutrient bouillon.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 12-hour settling in ice-chest before filtration; glycerine 4% final addition; double filtration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potato Gelatine (Elsner)
rubrics_metrics.description: 1 kg potatoes processed as for glycerine potato bouillon; add 15% gelatine to potato decoction and bubble live steam 10 minutes, estimate reaction and adjust reaction of medium mass to +25, cool to <60°C and clarify with egg, add 1% powdered potassium iodide, filter through papier Chardin, tube and sterilise as for nutrient gelatine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust reaction to +25 (strongly alkaline); add KI 1% as characteristic supplement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aesculin Agar
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare 400 c.c distilled water in a tared 2-L flask and add agar 15 g, peptone 10 g, sodium taurocholate 5 g (ingredients listing continues). (B. coli and allied organisms give black colonies surrounded by black halo.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator medium: aesculin hydrolysis gives black colonies/halo; full formulation includes agar/peptone/taurocholate and further specific steps for dissolution, clarification, filtration and sterilisation comparable to nutrient agar.
